messages:
Alex: Heads-up — vendor just called: SEA allocation for April is down ~18% (customs backlog + a DOA batch). We need ~38 units to keep commitments.
Maya: Oof. Which model/serials? Any chance to pull from other pools?
Alex: H100s, S/N ~30001-31500. EWR has 10 available, AMS has 4 but long re-route.
Sam: Cross-region transfer estimate: freight + brokerage ~= $1.5k/unit if we expedite (air), or diversion surcharge ~$1.1k per AWB for reroute at hub. Sea LTL too slow.
Dina: Vendor offered loaners at $40/day/unit for 30 days and a parallel expedited RMA lane for 12 units (5 business days). RMA timeline for rest = 10-14 business days.
Luis: Quick cost compare: loaner 30d = $1.2k/unit. Spot marketplace buys ~30% premium = +$5k/unit. Crossship per-unit varies based on AWB packing density.
Maya: We need 38. Options: 1) divert some AWBs from EWR/AMS, 2) take loaners for bulk shortfall, 3) spot-buy a few to bridge.
ProcureBot: PO 87621 status: approver workflow triggered for ad-hoc spend >$35k.
Sam: Ops note — provisioning mapping for loaner_serial -> production_node is ~3hrs per 8 units. Ops slack bandwidth this sprint = constrained.
Dina: RMA documentation ask: vendor requires manifest-level DOA photos + depot acceptance scan before issuing credit. Ops can deliver photos in ~24-36h if prioritized.
LogisticsBot: AWB created: 883-112-4422 for EWR consolidation. Current ETA EWR 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Diversion allowed? Yes. Surcharge estimate per AWB = $1090.
Alex: Vendor also said they can bump insured declared value to match PO but need signed amendment. They offered $1k AWB credit if we accept expedited 12-unit RMA lane.
Luis: If vendor gives $1k AWB credit + 12 expedited units, we might reduce spot buy to 8 units. Spot buy delta cost = ~ $40k incremental vs negotiated.
Maya: Finance: any flexibility on the $35k threshold this week?
ProcureBot: FinanceOps: temporary approval possible with written exec sign-off.
Sam: Proposed mixed plan: divert 10 from EWR (pay AWB surcharge), accept 18 loaners, take 8 expedited RMA units, spot-buy 2 as fallback. That gives immediate cushion and lower spend.
Dina: Practical questions: who pays return for loaners? Vendor says they cover return within 30 days if we use their carrier; otherwise we pay. Need SOP for temporary serials and return manifest.
Alex: Action items: Maya -> loop execs for sign-off on spot spend; Luis -> draft amendment (insured value + AWB credit); Dina -> ops to prioritize DOA photos + temp-serial mapping doc; Sam -> confirm per-AWB and per-unit crossship cost with forwarder and lock surcharge. I'll consolidate and post exec summary.
Maya: Looping @CTO and @HeadOfFinance for quick sign-off.
Luis: Vendor reply: "We can advance 8 expedited replacements by next Wed and will apply $1k credit to one AWB if amendment signed today."
Sam: If we take that, reduce spot buy to 0 and increase loaners to 20 — lowers cash but increases operational mapping work. Ops can handle 20 if we reassign one engineer.
Dina: Ops confirms they can turn around manifest photos in 30h and will create temp-serial mapping template.
LogisticsBot: Update: AWB 883-112-4422 diversion planned. New ETA SWA hub 2026-03-30 08:30 UTC. Surcharge locked at $1085.
Maya: Final call — react with :thumbsup: to approve mixed plan (10 divert + 20 loaners + 8 expedited RMA + amendment). Otherwise propose alt now.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Luis: :thumbsup: drafting amendment now.
Sam: :thumbsup: locking forwarder.
Dina: :thumbsup: ops prioritized.
ProcureBot: Exec sign-off requested: please confirm by EOD.
Maya: I'll send the exec summary and PO change request once sign-off comes through. Thanks team.
